uncited: **Chunk Eligibility**: The system iterates through loaded voxel chunks and matches them to items based on resolution level [12572-block-lod-instancing.md].
**Candidate Generation**: The item's `generator` evaluates conditions (e.g., noise thresholds) at candidate positions within eligible chunks [Parent].

**Surface Snapping (Optional)**: If enabled, the system queries the terrain generator for Signed Distance Field (SDF) values at candidate positions and nearby samples, interpolating to find the zero-crossing surface [12566-voxel-instancing-system.md].
This is an interpolation approximation, not exact ray-casting, and may fail if the terrain is edited after generation [12566-voxel-instancing-system.md].
**Normal Offset**: The instance position is displaced along the interpolated surface normal by `offset_along_normal` [12566-voxel-instancing-system.md].
**Alignment**: Instances are rotated to align with either the local terrain origin (sphere mode) or a fixed world up vector [12566-voxel-instancing-system.md].
**Instance Creation**: Instances are created as either `MultiMesh` (high-performance, static) or `Scene` (dynamic, scriptable) types [12566-voxel-instancing-system.md].
